name: Small physiotherapy clinics and no-shows
description: Five fictional interviews with owners and front-desk staff of small physiotherapy clinics.
product_idea: Software that reduces missed appointments for small clinics.

hypotheses.text: No-shows are a major source of lost revenue for small clinics.
Patients want to book their appointments online themselves.
Clinic owners would switch practice-management software to reduce no-shows.
Clinics would charge a cancellation fee if the software enforced it automatically.
